findings.passage: The key to ensuring that our voter rolls are free from illegal immigrants is careful monitoring.
findings.note: Senate update (posted 2025-03-26, headed March 25) on HB2020, which has the vehicle-licence agency send the Secretary of State quarterly lists of licences issued to noncitizens, to be compared with voter rolls. Flagged names are removed within five business days. He notes the bill has the county officer tell the person they may be reinstated by providing proof of citizenship.
subjects: proof of citizenship to be reinstated on voter rolls

findings.passage: The bill would require the county election officer to notify such person that they may be reinstated on the voter registration rolls by providing proof of their citizenship.
findings.note: Same update, describing the reinstatement step in HB2020 for people removed from the rolls as suspected noncitizens.
subjects: proof of citizenship to be reinstated on voter rolls

findings.passage: Most Americans believe that only citizens should vote in our elections.
findings.note: Senate update on HCR5004, the constitutional amendment (on the November 2026 ballot if approved) saying a qualified elector must be a US citizen, 18 or older, and resident of the voting area. He gives non-citizen voting as the reason for it.

findings.passage: To ensure this doesn’t happen in Kansas, the legislature adopted HCR5004, which if approved by voters, on the ballot in November of 2026, would amend Section 1 of Article 5 of the Kansas Constitution to clarify that no person shall be deemed a qualified elector unless such person is a citizen of the United States, has attained the age of 18, and, unless a residency exception applies to such person, resides in the voting area in which such person seeks to vote.
findings.note: Same update, describing HCR5004 and its stated aim of keeping non-citizens from voting in Kansas.

findings.passage: SB4 passed and will set the cut off for receipt of advance ballots to 7:00 p.m. on Election Day, the same deadline all other votes must be cast by in order to be counted.
findings.note: Senate update (Feb. 18) reporting passage of SB4, ending the grace period for receipt of advance ballots. He adds that a federal appeals court ruled grace periods unconstitutional. Fetch tool returned the sentence in two quoted parts; joined here. Also reports SB6, a ranked-choice voting ban.
